mechanics.name: Counterforce
mechanics.currentEffect: Your Totem cleansing speed is set to 125%. Each Totem you cleanse adds a stackable 25% cleansing-speed bonus. After each cleanse, the Aura of the Totem farthest from your current location is revealed to you for 10/12/14 seconds.
activation: Cleansing speed bonus is always active.
Cleanse a Totem to gain another stack and reveal the farthest Totem.
Ends/deactivates when: Farthest Totem Aura reveal ends after 10/12/14 seconds.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.0.0): Increased the bonus Totem cleansing speed to 25% and the farthest-Totem Aura reveal to 10/12/14 seconds.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: You cleanse Totems faster, gain additional cleansing speed per Totem cleansed, and see the farthest Totem after each cleanse.
duration: Farthest Totem Aura reveal: 10/12/14 seconds by tier.
mechanics.tokenOrStackBehavior: Permanent base cleansing speed is 125%; each cleansed Totem adds +25% stackable speed.

editorial.summary: Cleanse Totems at 125% base speed, gain another stacking 25% cleanse-speed bonus per Totem, and reveal the farthest Totem after each cleanse.
useCases: Chain Totem locations across the map using the farthest-Totem Aura reveal.
Support Overzealous or anti-Hex strategies with much faster cleansing.
counters: Provides little value when Totems are strategically irrelevant.
Travel time between far-apart Totems can dominate the saved cleanse time.
Cleansing every Dull Totem can interfere with Boon builds.
pros: Very fast cleansing after stacks build.
cons: Can waste objective time if used without a reason to cleanse.
analysis: Counterforce ranks this position because it is superb at exactly one job: deleting Totems. The permanent 125% cleansing baseline already improves the interaction, and every completed cleanse adds another twenty-five-percent stack.

The farthest-Totem Aura reveal lets the perk chain its own objective. Instead of wandering after each cleanse, the player receives a clear next destination, making a deliberate Totem sweep much more practical.

The problem is whether a Totem sweep was worth doing in the first place. Against a dangerous Hex build, absolutely. Against five harmless Dull Totems, spending the match cleansing them can be worse than ignoring the perk entirely.
Counterforce therefore deserves a lower-B specialist ranking. It is an excellent answer to the right Killer build and unnecessary labor against the wrong one.
editorial.verdict: A premier anti-Totem specialist. Counterforce is fantastic when Hexes matter and actively harmful if it convinces you every Dull Totem must die.
